title: The Drill Includes the Quiet Participant
premise: An event organizer wants a preparedness exercise that includes every attendee, but a verbal-only announcement omits a participant’s stated access needs. Consultation and qualified review add appropriate communication and assistance planning before the fictional drill proceeds.
hook: Who has not received the same usable information?
visible_action: An announcement wave reaches some figures but not all; requested communication channels connect before a review gate opens.
intended_takeaway_or_theme: Inclusive preparedness requires consultation, usable communication, and validated assistance arrangements.
gate: Consult affected people and qualified local authorities; never improvise lifting, transfer, rescue, or disability-specific tactics. Do not ask viewers to guess an emergency response or choose an action in a simulated emergency; any response content must come from reviewed official guidance.
